_comment: Single source of truth for the values that BOTH the web page and the offline
paint pipeline need to agree on.
This file exists because of a specific bug. Seven sketches under
scripts/paint/sketches/ each hardcoded `const PAPER = '#D9D0BE'`, a value
sampled by eye from a screenshot of the rendered page. It was correct only so
long as PaperBackground's three feTurbulence opacities never changed - and any
change to them would silently mismatch all seven plates at once.
Now: scripts/paint/render.mjs reads paper.rendered and injects it as the PAPER
global, and src/index.css declares paper.declared once in :root. main.jsx
asserts in dev that the browser actually paints paper.rendered, so the two can
never drift apart in silence again.

paper.note: declared is what :root sets; rendered is what the grain multiplies it down to, and is what plates must be painted on. Re-measure with scripts/paint/README.md's procedure if the grain opacities in PaperBackground.jsx change.

pigments._note: Mirrors WC.PIGMENTS in scripts/paint/watercolour.js. The interface draws its per-section accents from this box so the UI and the paintings speak one language.

sectionAccents._note: Each panel carries the lead pigment of its own plate, so scrolling changes colour the way turning pages in a painted book does.
